content: Ndaiong aramas akan dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, ketin mahmahsanih:

content.text: “Nahna kan en Edom, ngehi me amwail imwintihti!
I pahn wiahkihla omw kahnimw kan mohn kahnimw kei
Eri, ke ahpw pahn esehla me ngehi iei KAUN-O.

content: “Ke wia en Israel eh imwintihti poatopoat oh kemehla nah aramas akan ni ahnsoun eh paisuwed, ni ahnsoun eh lokolongki dipe kan.
Eri met, I kahukihla nin duwen ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Koht ieias—mehla iei imwilahmw, oh ke sohte kak pitsang. Ke dipkidahr dipen kamaramas, oh kamaramas me pahn idawehn uhk.
I pahn wiahkihla sahpw nahnahn Edom sapwtehn ehu oh kemehla aramas koaros me pahn seiloakla ie.
I pahn kadirehkihla nahna kan paliweren me melahr akan, oh paliweren irail kan me kamakamalahr nan mahwen pahn kadirehla pohn dohl kan oh nan wahu kan.
I pahn wiahkinuhkala sapwtehn ehu kohkohlahte, oh sohte me pahn pwurehng kousoan nan omw kahnimw kan. Eri, ke ahpw pahn esehla me ngehi iei KAUN-O.
“Ke kahski me dene wehi riau, Suda oh Israel, iangahki sapwara kan, iei uhdahn sapwomw oh ke pahn kolokol ira, mehnda ma ngehi, KAUN-O, me wia ar Koht.

Eri met, I kahukihla nin duwen ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Koht ieias, me I pahn dupukohng uhk omw lingeringer, omw peirin, oh omw kailongki nei aramas akan. Re pahn ese me I kalokalokehkin uhk dahme ke wiahiongirailehr.
Ke ahpw pahn esehla me ngehi, KAUN-O, karongeier duwen omw kahski ni mwamwahl me nahna kan en Israel wialahr sapwtehn oh e kohienguhker pwe ke en kangala.
I karongeier duwen omw lokaia mwamwahl oh suwei me ke lahlahwehkin ie.”
KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, eri mahsanih, “I pahn wiahkinuhkala sapwtehn douluhl ehu me kahrehda sampah pwon pahn perenkihda omw pwupwudi,
duwehte omw perenkihda mwomwlahn Israel, me uhdahn nin limei. Nahna kan en Seir, ei, sahpw koaros en Edom, pahn wiahla sapwtehn. Eri, aramas koaros ahpw pahn esehla me ngehi iei KAUN-O.”
